name: Belvoir St Theatre Student Saver tickets
summary: Discounted Student Saver and 30-Down tickets, plus concession prices for full-time students, at Belvoir in Surry Hills, Sydney.
key: Student Saver tickets are $37 Upstairs and $25 Downstairs.
who: Students (concession needs a full-time Australian student card).
30-Down prices ($47 Upstairs, $32 Downstairs) are also offered.
how: Choose the Student Saver price type when booking and bring proof.
catches: Student Saver and 30-Down apply to previews and selected sessions only.
Prices may change; check with the Box Office.

evidence.quote: Concession prices are available with a full-time Australian student card
30-Down and Student Saver prices are available for Previews, Wednesday evening, Thursday evening,
